sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: The crabs look carved from the mountain until they move. Moss and tiny flowers ride their stone shells while their claws test the road edge.

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: Player-safe note: Granite-shelled cliff crabs with moss and alpine flowers growing on their backs, stone-heavy claws, many gripping legs, and wary eyes made for vertical roads.

sections.title: GM truth
sections.body: No forced reveal. Let this entity disclose truth through scene context and player attention.

sections.title: GM handling
sections.body: Use as Titan's Steps texture: resource, danger, respect test, and a way to make vertical travel feel alive.
